mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_agreement_sign ( user_id, agreement_id, agreement_code, agreement_version, sign_no, sign_status, sign_scenario, related_order_no, ip_address, device_info, signed_at, content_hash, signature_data, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{agreementId}, #{agreementCode}, #{agreementVersion}, #{signNo}, #{signStatus}, #{signScenario}, #{relatedOrderNo}, #{ipAddress}, #{deviceInfo}, #{signedAt}, #{contentHash}, #{signatureData}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, agreement_id, agreement_code, agreement_version, sign_no, sign_status, sign_scenario, related_order_no, ip_address, device_info, signed_at, content_hash, signature_data, created_at, updated_at FROM user_agreement_sign WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND agreement_id = #{agreementId} AND sign_scenario = #{scenario} AND sign_status = 1 ORDER BY signed_at DESC LIMIT 1
